extracted.name: Apple-Stuffed Acorn Squash
extracted.description: In this vegetarian recipe for apple-stuffed acorn squash, Granny Smith apples and Cheddar cheese combine to make a delicious filling for squash halves.
ingredient_lines: 3 cups peeled, seeded, and chopped Granny Smith apples
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Place squash halves, cut-sides down, onto a baking sheet. Add enough water to come ½ inch up sides of the baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes. Drain off any remaining water.
Meanwhile, melt margarine in a large skillet over medium heat. Add apples and onions; cook until onions softened and turned translucent, 10 to 15 minutes. Transfer mixture to a bowl to cool.
When squash is cooked, stir Cheddar cheese, raisins, brown sugar, and cinnamon into apple mixture until evenly combined. Flip squash halves on the baking sheet; fill cavities with apple mixture.
Bake in the heated oven until filling is hot and cheese is melted, about 15 minutes.
